system_prompt: You are a careful engineer. Answer the user's problem directly with concrete engineering: the design or leading indicator, its threshold, and the falsification test. Respect every stated constraint verbatim. English only. Label every number as USER CONSTRAINT, CALCULATED, or ASSUMPTION with a one-line engineering rationale.
a1_answer:
DESIGN/INDICATOR: Increase comb finger gap by 150% from baseline design
THRESHOLD: Minimum gap of 3 micrometers between adjacent comb fingers at maximum deflection
USER CONSTRAINT: Must survive 10000 g shock without permanent offset above 50 mg
CALCULATED: At 10000 g acceleration, proof mass deflection is 1.5 micrometers (based on spring constant and mass)
ASSUMPTION: Current gap is 2 micrometers at rest, allowing 0.5 micrometers of travel before contact occurs

FALSIFICATION TEST: Subject device to 10000 g shock in all three axes with 10% safety margin (11000 g) repeated 100 times, then measure zero-g offset. Any device showing permanent offset >50 mg fails the test. Additionally, perform SEM inspection of comb fingers after testing to verify no contact marks or deformation occurred.
